goal_level_decision_audit.decision: Turn Barnes-Hut/vector-accumulation into a generic V3 engine-gap contract, not an app win.
goal_level_decision_audit.different_path_now: Use this packet to drive a generic fused vector-accumulation implementation and keep all M7, release, RT-core, and broad V3-over-V2 claims blocked until the primitive has fresh evidence.
goal_level_decision_audit.foolish_actions: The foolish action would be to sell route parity, contribution-row scale, or OptiX participation as Barnes-Hut RT-core acceleration while the fastest measured route is not RTDL/OptiX.
goal_level_decision_audit.other_path: Tune Barnes-Hut-specific code or keep quoting old M101/M121 reports. That might improve a demo, but it would not establish a language-level V3 capability.
goal_level_decision_audit.was_i_foolish: No. The evidence says the current prepared RTDL/OptiX frontier-emission route is slower than fused Numba CUDA, so the honest V3 move is to define the missing reusable primitive.

m6_route_parity_evidence.reading: M6 is serious route-parity evidence, but it is negative for the current prepared RTDL/OptiX frontier-emission shape: fused Numba CUDA is fastest at every rerun scale, and prepared RTDL/OptiX+Numba was slower than fused Numba CUDA by 5.120x to 13.912x on the 65,536 and 131,072 rows.

implemented_runtime.runtime_path: native CUDA fused aggregate-tree traversal and vector accumulation

rt_core_claim_requirements: OptiX implementation must launch an OptiX pipeline, not only CUDA kernels
device program must call optixTrace or equivalent hardware traversal
timing packet must separate BVH build, optixLaunch traversal, continuation, and copies
CUDA-only fused implementation may be useful device evidence but not RT-core evidence

v3_engine_decision: Keep Barnes-Hut as a V3 engine-gap driver, not a release win. The current app-agnostic aggregate-tree fused weighted-vector primitive now accumulates directly into device vector/count columns instead of emitting aggregate-frontier rows before vector math, but the scorecard blocker is not release-cleared.
